final-heat.publisher: 新潟県農業総合研究所 作物研究センター
final-heat.title: 休眠の深い水稲種子に適した浸種方法
final-heat.locator: PDF1 内容・留意点、PDF2 図の横軸
final-heat.finding: Uses accumulated water temperature with an explicit ℃・日 unit. Its 120℃・日 result is conditional on dormant Koshihikari/Gohyakumangoku seeds, a water temperature of 12℃, and chemically treated trial seeds; the paper excludes hot-water-disinfected seeds from that result. These conditions demonstrate why a temperature sum alone is not a universal end-of-soaking instruction.

final-heat.finding: The described effective-temperature accumulator subtracts a selected base temperature from hourly air temperature and divides hourly contributions by24. Used only to distinguish base-temperature-dependent thermal accumulation from the plain daily water-temperature sum used in the soaking explanation; no tea thresholds are transferred to rice.
